method: Read-only inspection of cloned default-branch histories using git log/show/diff, regression tests, control follow-up patches, revert/hash/subject searches, and git -S/-L. Follow-up claims end at the cloned tips named in evidence. code_files contains every non-test changed file, including accompanying documentation; code_lines_changed counts source-file additions plus deletions, including source comments and blank lines. Randomization used Python random.Random(20261012): sort cases by (project, full SHA), shuffle and assign rb01..rb36; randomly select four alphabetically listed projects to contribute two tuning bugs each, with the other four contributing one; shuffle each project's bugs in alphabetical project order and allocate accordingly. In alphabetical project order, shuffle each project's controls, putting one in each half when there are two; shuffle the four singleton controls and allocate two to each half. Finally shuffle tuning, then heldout. Each half has 12 BUG and 6 CONTROL, with bugs from all eight projects.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: The CLI truncates an option at '=' before extracting its value, so the value becomes empty. Running '-i premajor 1.0.0 --preid=beta' produces '2.0.0-0' instead of '2.0.0-beta.0'.
cases.evidence: fix(bin): get correct value from arg separated by equals (#449); test/bin/semver.js adds 'args with equals', comparing equals-separated and space-separated arguments; the changed snapshot corrects this exact prerelease output.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Incrementing a prerelease with a dotted identifier incorrectly resets its sequence. Incrementing '3.0.0-alpha.beta.5.4' with release 'prerelease' and identifier 'alpha.beta' yields '3.0.0-alpha.beta.0' instead of '3.0.0-alpha.beta.5.5'.
cases.evidence: fix: increment dotted prerelease identifiers (#870); test/fixtures/increments.js adds this exact regression, plus 'alpha.beta.5' and non-numeric suffix cases.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: With short-option-groups disabled, a negative number is mistaken for an option name. Parsing ['-1'] with configuration {'short-option-groups': false} produces an option named '1' instead of positional argv._ = [-1].
cases.evidence: fix: preserve negative number handling when short-option-groups:false (#511); test/yargs-parser.mjs adds 'should treat negative numbers as numbers when "short-option-groups" false', comparing both configurations.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Date.UTC interprets years 0000 through 0099 as 1900 through 1999, causing calendar validation to reject valid YAML timestamps. Loading '0001-01-01' leaves a string instead of creating the Date for 0001-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.
cases.evidence: Fix !!timestamp resolution for years 0000-0099, #775; test/core/tags/timestamp.test.mjs adds expected Dates for '0001-01-01' and '0050-06-15T12:30:00Z', and verifies '0001-02-29' remains invalid.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Removes a redundant argument-initialization check from the closing-quote branch because initialization still occurs immediately afterward.
cases.evidence: refactor: remove duplicate check for `args[i]` in tokenize-arg-string.js (#175); checked C..origin/main through aa386be6 with all patches in the .js file and its .ts successor, -S on the initialization statement, and revert/hash/#175/duplicate-check searches. Later numeric-array coercion, declaration changes, TypeScript conversion and license edits leave this branch intact; no corrective fix or revert was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds a date-construction context to fromUnixTime and simplifies getMilliseconds and getSeconds.
cases.evidence: Add tz support to fromUnixTime; checked C..origin/main through 717ce0a8 with subsequent patches for all three files and their pkgs/core successors, -S on the context-forwarding call, and revert/hash/function-name searches. Later changes concern types, docs, extensions or moves; all three runtime bodies remain intact, with no corrective fix or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds ignoreNewlineAtEof to line diffs so a final line can match an otherwise identical newline-terminated line.
cases.evidence: Add ignoreNewlineAtEof (#530); checked C..origin/master through 59476090 with history and full patches for src/diff/line.js and its .ts successor, -S ignoreNewlineAtEof, and revert/hash/#530/option-name searches. The sole later source change is dd1c4e0's TypeScript rewrite, which preserves this equality branch; no corrective fix or revert was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Rewrites plain-scalar matching regexes without lookbehind so the same logic can run in ES2015 environments.
cases.evidence: Remove regex lookbehind for ES2015 compatibility; checked C..origin/master through 78326247 with every later scalar_styler.ts patch, -S SRC_NS_PLAIN_CHAR_FLOW_OUT, and revert/hash/lookbehind/ES2015 searches. The only later file change exposes styling types and documentation; the regexes remain unchanged, with no corrective fix or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Exports a RELEASE_TYPES array of supported increment types through the public entry point.
cases.evidence: feat: export new RELEASE_TYPES constant; checked C..origin/main through 6e05b763 with file history, -S RELEASE_TYPES, -L on the constant, and revert/hash/RELEASE_TYPES/release-types searches. Later matches are docs/type tests; source fixes concern regex lengths, caching or strict directives, with no revert or corrective fix to this export found.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Minimum and maximum choose the wrong sign when positive and negative zero compare equal. Decimal.min(0, -0, 0) returns +0 and Decimal.max(-0, 0, 0) returns -0, reversing the required signed-zero tie handling.
cases.evidence: #241 Match Math.max and Math.min negative zero handling; test/modules/minAndMax.js adds permutations of positive and negative zero expecting min -0 and max +0, comparing valueOf strings so signs are observable.

cases.ground_truth:
BUG: Patch creation emits only one missing-newline marker when both replaced final lines lack newlines. Comparing 'line1
line2
line3
line4' with 'line1
line2
line3
line44' must mark both '-line4' and '+line44', but mutually exclusive branches omit the new-side marker.
cases.evidence: Fix: Missing "No newline at end of file" when comparing two texts that do not end in newlines (#94); test/patch/create.js adds 'should output "no newline" at end of file message on both missing nl', expecting a marker after each changed final line.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Interval endpoints are sorted lexicographically rather than numerically, which can reverse chronological bounds. isWithinInterval(new Date(2023, 11, 19), {start: new Date(2001, 8, 1), end: new Date(2023, 11, 20)}) incorrectly returns false.
cases.evidence: Fix isWithinInterval not sorting dates correctly; src/isWithinInterval/test.ts adds 'properly sorts the dates', asserting true for this interval spanning timestamps with different digit lengths.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Encoding an entire formatted URL percent-encodes the brackets required around IPv6 host literals. '[foo](http://[2001:db8::1]:1896/a[b]?x=[y])' gets an invalid encoded host instead of preserving its IPv6 brackets while encoding path and query brackets.
cases.evidence: fix: preserve IPv6 brackets in normalizeLink (#1204); test/fixtures/markdown-it/normalize.txt adds 'IPv6 address literals should preserve brackets while encoding other components', with this input and two further IPv6 fixtures.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Makes Set collection keys and values share the same iterator method and reuses collection prototype aliases in mixins.
cases.evidence: Use ES standard for iterator fmethod reuse (#1867); checked C..origin/main through 686b8baf with CollectionImpl.js history, -S SetCollectionPrototype.keys, -L around the alias/mixin block, and revert/hash/#1867/iterator-reuse searches. That block has no later edits; later fixes affect indexed has or ordered hashing, and later reverts concern other changes.

cases.ground_truth:
BUG: Flow presentation silently omits empty null sequence items because their rendered text is empty. Converting the AST of '-
' to flow style emits '[]
' instead of '[!!null]
', losing its sole element.
cases.evidence: Fix empty scalar items in flow sequences; test/core/ast/presenter.test.mjs adds 'tags an otherwise empty flow sequence item', covering a sole null and null before or after another item, with exact output and round-trip equality assertions.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Repeat.equals passes only one argument to the two-argument deepEqual helper, so comparing with undefined makes deepEqual see two undefined arguments. Repeat(1).equals(undefined) incorrectly returns true.
cases.evidence: Fix Repeat(<value>).equals(undefined) incorrectly returning true (#1994); __tests__/Repeat.ts adds 'does not claim to be equal to undefined', asserting Repeat(1).equals(undefined) is false.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Computing 1 - x*x loses precision through cancellation near |x| = 1. With precision 31 and rounding mode 1, asin('0.9999999999999999995') returns '1.570796325794896619231321691573' instead of '1.570796325794896619231321691598'.
cases.evidence: Fix asin losing precision near x = 1; test/modules/asin.js adds four near-unit regressions, including this exact precision, rounding mode and expected result; old and fixed outputs were reproduced from historical source in memory.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Array diffing inherits string-token filtering, which discards false, 0 and empty strings before comparing. diffArrays(['', 0, false, 0, false, ''], [false, 0, '', false, 0, 0, false]) reports an empty unchanged result instead of the actual edits.
cases.evidence: Fix: diffArrays can compare falsey items; test/diff/array.js adds 'should diff falsey values' with these exact arrays and an expected seven-component edit sequence.
